название: Tweet Scraper V2 - X Scraper / Twitter Scraper / X.com Scraper

схема.title: Tweet Scraper
схема.description: The last Tweet Scraper you will ever need. Get the results you want with the most powerful Twitter(X) scraper on the market.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Twitter (X) URLs. Paste the URLs and get the results immediately. Tweet, Profile, Search or List URLs are supported.

searchTerms.title: Search Terms
searchTerms.description: Search terms you want to search from Twitter (X). You can refer to https://github.com/igorbrigadir/twitter-advanced-search.

twitterHandles.title: Twitter handles
twitterHandles.description: Twitter handles that you want to search on Twitter (X)

conversationIds.title: Conversation IDs
conversationIds.description: Conversation IDs that you want to search on Twitter (X)

maxItems.title: Maximum number of items on output
maxItems.description: Maximum number of items that you want as output.

sort.title: Sort By
sort.description: Sorts search results. If you are getting low results, try Top instead of Latest. Latest + Top runs both simultaneously to maximize results but may return some duplicate tweets.

tweetLanguage.title: Tweet language
tweetLanguage.description: Restricts tweets to the given language, given by an ISO 639-1 code.
enumTitles: Church Slavonic, Old Slavonic, Old Church Slavonic
tweetLanguage.sectionDescription: You can filter tweets by using these options.

onlyVerifiedUsers.title: Only verified users
onlyVerifiedUsers.description: If selected, only returns tweets by users who are verified.

onlyTwitterBlue.title: Only Twitter Blue
onlyTwitterBlue.description: If selected, only returns tweets by users who are Twitter Blue subscribers.

onlyImage.title: Only image
onlyImage.description: If selected, only returns tweets that contain images.

onlyVideo.title: Only video
onlyVideo.description: If selected, only returns tweets that contain videos.

onlyQuote.title: Only quote
onlyQuote.description: If selected, only returns tweets that are quotes.

author.title: Tweet author
author.description: Returns tweets sent by the given user. It should be a Twitter (X) Handle.
author.sectionDescription: Use this wizard to easily search anything from Twitter (X) and get the results.

inReplyTo.title: In reply to
inReplyTo.description: Returns tweets that are replies to the given user. It should be a Twitter (X) Handle.

mentioning.title: Mentioning
mentioning.description: Returns tweets mentioning the given user. It should be a Twitter (X) Handle.

geotaggedNear.title: Geotagged near
geotaggedNear.description: Returns tweets sent near the given location.

withinRadius.title: Within radius
withinRadius.description: Returns tweets sent within the given radius of the given location.

geocode.title: Geocode
geocode.description: Returns tweets sent by users located within a given radius of the given latitude/longitude.

placeObjectId.title: Place object ID
placeObjectId.description: Returns tweets tagged with the given place.

minimumRetweets.title: Minimum retweets
minimumRetweets.description: Returns tweets with at least the given number of retweets.

minimumFavorites.title: Minimum favorites
minimumFavorites.description: Returns tweets with at least the given number of favorites.

minimumReplies.title: Minimum replies
minimumReplies.description: Returns tweets with at least the given number of replies.

start.title: Start date
start.description: Returns tweets sent after the given date.

end.title: End date
end.description: Returns tweets sent before the given date.

includeSearchTerms.title: Include Search Terms
includeSearchTerms.description: If selected, a field will be added to each tweets about the search term that was used to find it.
includeSearchTerms.sectionDescription: The section where you can tweak your output in an advanced way.

customMapFunction.title: Custom map function
customMapFunction.description: Function that takes each of the objects as argument and returns data that will be mapped by the function itself. This function is not intended for filtering, please don't use it for filtering purposes or you will get banned automatically.
